name_en: Aji no maruzushi — whole horse mackerel cured and rolled with shiso around vinegared rice
summary_ja: 梅酢でしめたアジを丸ごと開き、酢飯を包んで赤しそで巻いた佐伯市の祝いずし。骨や内臓を丁寧に取り除く手間のかかる仕事で、豊後水道の脂ののったアジが手に入る土地ならではの一品とされる。
summary_en: A whole horse mackerel, cured in plum vinegar and opened flat, is wrapped around vinegared rice and rolled in red shiso leaf — a celebratory sushi from Saiki, painstaking to prepare, built on the rich mackerel landed from the Bungo Channel.
source_title: あじの丸ずし 大分県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Mosso-zushi — pressed sushi molded in a square wooden box, topped with white fish
summary_ja: 人参やごぼう、干ししいたけを煮込んで混ぜた酢飯を、木製の正方形の型「物相」に詰めて押しかためる中津市・宇佐市の祝いずし。米が貴重だった時代に皆へ等分するための型だったと伝わり、仕上げに白身魚を添える。
summary_en: Vinegared rice mixed with simmered carrot, burdock, and dried shiitake is packed into a square wooden mold called mosso and pressed firm — a festival sushi from Nakatsu and Usa said to have used the mold to portion out rice equally in leaner times, finished with a slice of white fish.
source_title: 物相ずし 大分県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Okata-zushi — rice balls of sweetened rice, seasoned mackerel, and simmered kidney beans
summary_ja: 酢飯に焼きほぐしたアジと甘く煮たうずら豆を混ぜ、俵状に握る大分市竹中地区のすし。庄屋（お方）が農繁期を前に小作人をねぎらう「地獄入り」という行事で振る舞ったのがはじまりと伝わる。
summary_en: Vinegared rice is mixed with flaked grilled horse mackerel and sweet simmered kidney beans, then shaped into oblong rice balls — a sushi from the Chikunaka district of Oita City said to have begun as a village headman's treat for tenant farmers before the hard labor of the growing season began.
source_title: お方ずし 大分県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
